name: wows-omp-plugin-roadmap
description: Tool-managed project rounds, stages and TODOs, with stage-linked ADRs through the adr plugin

uiMenu.description: Open /roadmap as a fullscreen console with fullscreen write previews, or keep the inline select menus

stageOrder.description: List stages in dependency order (dependencies first, ties by id) or by stage id in consoles, menus, completions and agent status

planningGate.description: At stage start, ask before planning a stage small enough to implement directly, or implementing a large stage without a plan

planningGateConfidence.description: How confident (0-1) the native judge must be about a stage's size before the planning check asks
